$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — S7 (CE-2158 F-c) bounding overwatch. From the header's Judge (4)-(5), reduced: the squad runs the BoundingOverwatch task, nobody fires until a rifleman is within 100 m of the Hostile (it is unseen until ~70 m; 100 m leaves margin so a sampled step cannot misfire the rule), and once they close, the squad fires at the Hostile (the take's contact at 17.8 s was the first round). NOT expressed: (1) halves not moving together, (2) bounds ending within 1.5 m of cover, (3) swaps on 'set' - they read the squad maneuver's history over HTTP, not a component; (5)'s 3.5 s / 5.5 s suppress windows - contact itself is not readable.
